title: NVIDIA Just Put 50,000 Cores in ONE GPU 🤯
description:
NVIDIA just put more than 50,000 CUDA cores on a single GPU — and it's not for gaming.

Rubin HPC is a new GPU in NVIDIA's Vera Rubin platform, announced at the SC26 supercomputing conference. NVIDIA calls its CUDA-core count a record: more than 50,000 on one GPU, over double the RTX 5090's 21,760. It's built for simulation and analytics in science and engineering, with sparse data acceleration and 7th-gen NVLink. The catch: no price, memory size or power figure yet, and NVIDIA expects it to be available in 2028.

By our Spec or Wreck score: 55/100 → SPEC, for science labs, not gamers.
